bricks.description: STYLE: raw monochrome 35mm black-and-white street photograph shot on pushed ISO 3200 film with silver-gelatin darkroom contrast: coarse organic silver grain, crushed ink-black shadows swallowing background clutter, chalk-white blown highlights under direct compact flash, slight motion blur and candid asymmetrical framing, zero grey digital smoothness. Strictly black-and-white; no colour tint, no sepia, no CGI polish.
bricks.when: A raw night, a city, a song without comfort.

bricks.description: STYLE: a fine-art silver gelatin darkroom print on fibre paper: long smooth tonal range from deep velvet blacks to soft paper whites, fine even grain, gentle edge burning and a faint warm paper base. Strictly monochrome; no colour, no harsh digital contrast, no HDR.
bricks.when: A quiet, timeless portrait or still life.

bricks.description: STYLE: a lith darkroom print: grainy infectious-developer blacks with sharp contrast, soft creamy highlights and slightly peppery shadow texture, a subtle warm-brown tone in the midtones only. Black-and-white with a faint chemical warmth; no colour objects, no clean digital gradients.
bricks.when: For melancholy with a handmade, chemical feel.

bricks.description: STYLE: a charcoal drawing on rough toothy paper in strong chiaroscuro: soft smudged blacks built in layers, kneaded-eraser highlights lifting light out of the dark, visible paper grain and finger smears. Monochrome charcoal only; no ink lines, no colour, no digital brushes.
bricks.when: Drama, a face out of darkness, a heavy verse.

bricks.description: STYLE: a bold relief linocut print: carved white gouge marks cutting through flat black ink, chunky simplified shapes, slight ink-starved texture and paper show-through at the edges. Pure black ink on off-white paper only; no greys, no shading gradients, no colour.
bricks.when: For a protest, a myth, a stark poster.

bricks.description: STYLE: a medical X-ray radiograph look: translucent glowing white structures against a deep black field, soft internal density layers, faint film scratches and a cool neutral tone. Monochrome only; no colour, no anatomical gore, no illustration lines.
bricks.when: For what is inside, a hidden truth, fragility.

bricks.description: STYLE: a coarse black halftone newspaper print: visible round dot screen, slight misregistration and ink bleed into cheap grey newsprint, high contrast and crushed midtones. Black ink on grey paper only; no colour, no smooth photo gradients.

STYLE: a cyanotype sun print: deep Prussian-blue ground with pale white silhouettes and soft exposure falloff, slight brush-coated edges and paper fibres. Blue monochrome only; no other colours, no sharp digital edges.
bricks.when: For botany, memory, a dream in blue.
